Class AdjustmentTriggerHandlerTest

@IsTest()
private class AdjustmentTriggerHandlerTest

Test class for AdjustmentTriggerHandler and AdjustmentTriggerHelper. Validates short description truncation on insert/update and field replication to BillAdjustment__c on update.
